2981|72360bcb.name: Chief Hawkwind
2981|72360bcb.text: Hail, $c. In my years I have seen many eager $r who wish to prove their worth to the tribe. It should not be forgotten that eagerness is no substitute for wisdom and experience.

1060-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
1060-accept.text:
You've done so well for me, $N. You're a regular lucky rabbit's foot and there's something I want you to see.

The harpies are not from around the Barrens. They come from a place called Stonetalon, far to the northwest of here. Though it is probably a dangerous place for you, I need this letter delivered to an old friend of mine who lives there, a witch doctor by the name of Jin'Zil.

He'll be happy to know that Serena Bloodfeather is dead, and I think you'll find Stonetalon an interesting place.
1060-accept.title: Letter to Jin'Zil

1069-complete.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-complete.text:
You got them!  Thank you!

I'll have these sent to Dizzywig and get them shipped to Booty Bay.  I can already taste the profits!

Here is your cut, $N.  I couldn't have made this deal without you.
1069-complete.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1069-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-progress.text: Did you get the eggs, $N?  I already made a shipping deal with Wharfmaster Dizzywig!
1069-progress.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1093-accept.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-accept.text:
Terrible what the Venture Company has done here, eh? What were they thinking? Goblin company hiring a gnome!

Lucky for me, Sputtervalve knows a genius when he sees one. Hired me just after I'd been kicked out!

Tells me they built some enormous woodcutting machine, and Sput' wants me to steal the plans for him. Unfortunately, Gerenzo--bloody gnome--wants me dead on sight... maybe you could steal the plans for me? You should be able to find them on one of their operators.
1093-accept.title: Super Reaper 6000

1483-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1483-complete.text:
I thought those Venture Company higher-ups were slave drivers, but then I met Sputtervalve, the cruelest of them all!

Ha! Though it's better than being out of a job, I suppose... Or worse, working with that Gerenzo. If you're here to help, I've got something for you to do.
1483-complete.title: Ziz Fizziks

1528-accept.name: Searn Firewarder
1528-accept.text:
Water be in ya future, mon. I see you be strong in da ways of fire already, an' me tinkin' you be ready to talk to Islen.

Islen live along the coast of da Barrens. If ya head south along the Southfury River, ya canna miss her--look fer da big shark! She be strong in da ways of da elements and can teach ya da ways of water... if you tink you be ready.

She be easy ta find, just don' go too far south--she be jus' beyond Ratchet.
1528-accept.title: Call of Water

3922-complete.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3922-complete.text: Great, you got them!  Now I can get to work...
3922-complete.title: Nugget Slugs

3922-progress.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3922-progress.text: Do you have the nugget slugs, $N?  I've been eyeing this Samophlange and I can't wait to tinker with it.
3922-progress.title: Nugget Slugs

3923-accept.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3923-accept.text:
Well, that didn't work.  I put some extra gauges on the samophlange to measure its structural integrity, and they read the integrity at an all-time low.  I could add some more dials and maybe a lever or two to try and fix it, but... I think that might make things even worse.

You should take the samophlange to Rilli Greasygob.  He used to work for the Venture Company -- if anyone knows how to fix it, it's Rilli.

You can find him at Nogg's Machine Shop in Orgrimmar, in the Valley of Honor.
3923-accept.title: Rilli Greasygob

3923-complete.name: Rilli Greasygob
3923-complete.text:
What's this?  Why, it's a samophlange!  Where did you get this thing?  Have you been poking around the Venture Company holdings in the Barrens?

You must be very brave, or very stupid.
3923-complete.title: Rilli Greasygob

3923-progress.name: Rilli Greasygob
3923-progress.text: Mind your head!  I don't want it to get in the way of my work!
3923-progress.title: Rilli Greasygob

3924-accept.name: Rilli Greasygob
3924-accept.text:
I think I can fix the samophlange, but I'm going to need the user's manual first.  When I was in the Venture Company I had a rival, Boss Copperplug, who hoarded the secrets of the samophlange, giving out small bits of knowledge on the device to those he trusted.  I wasn't one of the trusted few...

Boss Copperplug used to stay at the Boulder Lode Mine in northeastern Barrens.  Get the manual from him, and if he's given pages from it to anyone, you'll have to collect them too.
3924-accept.title: Samophlange Manual

6284-complete.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6284-complete.text:
Good hunting, $N! Besseleth is an old predator in these parts... I will miss her not. Take this reward as a token for being the forest champion.

<Maggran rubs the wound caused by Besseleth.>

Perhaps now many more will travel to Sun Rock Retreat without fearing what lurks in the dark.
6284-complete.title: Arachnophobia

6284-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6284-progress.text: Besseleth is a ruthless predator... I fear for those that travel Webwinder Path at night. It's then that she and her children prey upon innocent travelers. I myself fell prey to her two-foot fang of death, but luckily I was able to fend her off and get to safety. I would give anything to see that monster destroyed.
6284-progress.title: Arachnophobia

6461-complete.name: Xen'Zilla
6461-complete.text:
Sweet, mon! Good news, perhaps we will have fewer unwanted dinner guests tonight.

Many thanks, $N.  We are forever in your debt.
6461-complete.title: Blood Feeders

747-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-progress.text: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a hunter before the Chief.
747-progress.title: The Hunt Begins

863-complete.name: Sputtervalve
863-complete.text:
Hopefully we'll be able to get something of value from the wrecked shredder prototype... my time's running out! I'll dispatch a salvage team to Wizzlecrank's location on the double.

Oh, let me give you something for your trouble, too.
863-complete.title: The Escape

876-complete.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-complete.text: HA! Well done, $N! Very well done... I wasn't sure you were up to the task, but you've proved yourself quite the cut-throat. Thank you again for helping us suppress the Harpy epidemic. Here is your reward, use it well.
876-complete.title: Serena Bloodfeather

876-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-progress.text: You're not getting anything until I see Serena's head.
876-progress.title: Serena Bloodfeather
